children: ended Friday’s session with a gain of more than 5% as BofA Securities rated the stock as a Buy to reflect additional margin expansion, opportunities in underserved markets, and an underappreciated value proposition among health-conscious consumers.

Analyst Vicky Liu believes NGVC’s “Always Affordable” pricing – on average 15% less than Sprouts Farmers Market – should resonate as more financially-pressured health-conscious consumers seek value amidst an increasing inflationary environment.

Moreover, with only 174 stores across 22 states, NGVC remains significantly underpenetrated, and its attractive unit economics allow the company to enter markets that may not support larger specialty grocers.
Liu also sees significant potential in NGVC’s e-commerce opportunities, bolstered by its recent DoorDash

"Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage’s replicable small-box format, lean operations, and ability to operate in small markets at a profit will continue to support its competitive pricing model and a higher EBIT margin than conventional grocers," Liu notes.
In addition to rating the stock a Buy, Liu assigns a $35 price target, representing 13% upside to Friday’s closing price.
Shares of Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage
have gained 24% year-to-date, outperforming the S&P 500 by more than 2x.

title: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage gains new bull at BofA
